how.name: Effectiveness
how.body: Task success. Can they finish the job. A drop here can show later churn.

how.name: Ease
how.body: How easy the work feels. Customer Effort sits here. Low effort tends to hold people.

how.name: Efficiency
how.body: Time, steps, rework, or assists. Use the median so one slow attempt does not skew it.

how.name: Confidence
how.body: Do they understand and feel safe proceeding. Rechecking and hesitation sit here.

how.name: Usefulness
how.body: Does it meet the need. A feature they ignore is a later churn risk.

how.name: Satisfaction
how.body: How they feel after the work. CSAT and SUS sit here. Company NPS stays too broad for one feature.

how.name: Engagement
how.body: How often they come back and what they use. Adoption and stickiness are leading. Retention and churn are lagging.

how.name: Operational
how.body: Errors, tickets, and wait. High friction here drives churn. Track this with logs and support, not gut feel.

how.name: Accessibility
how.body: Can they use it. Failures block the work. A high average cannot cancel them.

structure.name: Product-wide
structure.body: A small set for the whole product. Adoption, retention, CSAT or SUS, and help volume sit here.

structure.name: Area
structure.body: Each product surface gets its own KEIs. Portfolio, Alerts, Queries, Reports, Users, and Finance. Do not invent an area the product does not have.

structure.name: Primary
structure.body: One headline per area. Task success is the usual thermometer.

structure.name: Diagnostic
structure.body: Two to four supporting scores. Time, effort, errors, or abandon, to explain the headline.

cuts.name: Product area
cuts.body: Portfolio, Alerts, Queries, Reports, Users, or Finance. Alerts and Queries cover faults. Meters sit in Portfolio.

cuts.name: Journey or task
cuts.body: A named flow inside that area. Success and time are per task, not a blended average.

cuts.name: Test type
cuts.body: Lab, live use, survey, or support. Do not mix them in one score.

cuts.name: User role
cuts.body: A named group from User groups. Do not invent a hat.

cuts.name: Time
cuts.body: A window with a sample. A wide band means wait for more data.
